name: Champaign Public Library Volunteers
what_you_do: Help the library with sorting and shelving, bookstore cashier shifts, storytime help, a summer Club Fred program and other listed roles. Training is provided.
who_can_apply: Volunteers must be at least 16. If you are 16 or 17 you need a signed waiver from a parent or guardian.
duration: Typically 2 to 3 hours a week; a 4-month minimum is preferred
how_to_apply: Complete the online volunteer application, then schedule the required interview. Contact: Eva Liu, Volunteer Coordinator, volunteer@champaign.org, 217-403-2000 x3.
notes: Open roles change, so look at the current listings on the page. The Douglass Branch's Club Fred program is a summer role.
